fusions.name: Loosed Blade
fusions.desc: Looses the blade from your hand at a target, where it deals 4 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at its full reach of 8 tiles.

fusions.name: Four to the String
fusions.desc: After a 1.2 second draw, looses 4 blades at once in a spread out to 8 tiles, each of which deals 9 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Strung Sentinel
fusions.desc: Sets a blade hovering at full draw for 15 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds it looses at an enemy within 6 tiles and deals 5 damage.

fusions.name: Tension in the Draw
fusions.desc: After 6 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 35% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.
